How to get an RSS feed URL
  1. Open a news site you like (The Hindu, BBC, Google News, etc.).
  2. Look for an RSS / Feed link, often in the footer, or try adding /rss or /feed to the section URL.
  3. Example Tamil Nadu feed: paste
    https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/tamil-nadu/feeder/default.rss
  4. Or use a search like “site name RSS feed” in Google and copy the .rss / .xml link.
  5. Paste that full URL below and save the alert.

Must start with https://

How to set up ntfy (phone alerts)
  1. Install the free ntfy app: ntfy.sh (Android / iOS / web).
  2. Open the app → Subscribe to topic.
  3. Type a unique name only you know, e.g. notify-sam-chennai (no spaces). Avoid public words like “test”.
  4. Type the same topic name in the box below on this site → Save ntfy.
  5. Tap Send test notification here. You should get a push on your phone within a few seconds.
How to set up Telegram
  1. Install Telegram and open it.
  2. Search for @userinfobot → Start. It replies with your numeric Id (e.g. 123456789).
  3. Copy that number into Telegram chat ID below → Save Telegram.
  4. Important: the Notify server also needs a Telegram bot token on the backend (TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN). Without that, Telegram delivery won’t send yet — ntfy works without extra setup.
  5. After the bot is configured, message your bot once (Start), then use Send test notification.
